fullPassage: Deep work is when you perform an activity with deep concentration that pushes your cognitive capabilities, and by doing so create new value and improve your skills. These efforts are hard to replicate; and to be able to do deep work, we need a distraction-free environment. For many people though, we spend far too much time on the other end of the scale, doing what is referred to as shallow work. This style of working is not cognitively demanding but is rather an execution of logical-type tasks that rarely create new value (although they may still be important). We often perform these tasks while we are distracted. Shallow work has its place, both because routine-type tasks need to be done and because we cannot spend our entire time doing deep work. The problem with too much shallow work is that we feel busy, maybe even stressed, but we rarely see any output reflecting our experienced effort.

det.analysis: output을 후치수식하는 현재분사가 필요. 동사 reflect를 현재분사 reflecting으로 변환. 'any output reflecting our experienced effort'(우리의 경험한 노력을 반영하는 산출물)
det.tip: 현재분사 후치수식: output(명사) + reflecting(현재분사) = 반영하는 산출물

overlay.excerptSentences: The problem with too much shallow work is that we feel busy, maybe even stressed, but we rarely see any output __________ (reflect) our experienced effort.

questions.passage: Deep work is when you perform an activity with deep concentration that pushes your cognitive capabilities, and by doing so create new value and improve your skills. These efforts are hard to replicate; and to be able to do deep work, we need a distraction-free environment. For many people though, we spend far too much time on the other end of the scale, doing what is referred to as shallow work. This style of working is not cognitively demanding but is rather an execution of logical-type tasks that rarely create new value (although they may still be important). We often perform these tasks while we are distracted. Shallow work __________, both because routine-type tasks need to be done and because we cannot spend our entire time doing deep work. The problem with too much shallow work is that we feel busy, maybe even stressed, but we rarely see any output reflecting our experienced effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① should be eliminated entirely: '완전히 제거해야 한다'는 shallow work도 역할이 있다는 원문과 모순
✅ ② has its place: '나름의 자리가 있다'는 routine 과제 수행 등의 이유로 shallow work도 필요하다는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ lacks any practical purpose: '실용적 목적이 없다'는 important할 수 있다는 원문과 모순
❌ ④ is always harmful to productivity: '항상 생산성에 해롭다'는 원문의 균형 잡힌 시각과 불일치
det.tip: has its place = 나름의 역할/자리가 있다

questions.passage: Deep work is when you perform an activity with deep concentration that __________, and by doing so create new value and improve your skills. These efforts are hard to replicate; and to be able to do deep work, we need a distraction-free environment. For many people though, we spend far too much time on the other end of the scale, doing what is referred to as shallow work. This style of working is not cognitively demanding but is rather an execution of logical-type tasks that rarely create new value (although they may still be important). We often perform these tasks while we are distracted. Shallow work has its place, both because routine-type tasks need to be done and because we cannot spend our entire time doing deep work. The problem with too much shallow work is that we feel busy, maybe even stressed, but we rarely see any output reflecting our experienced effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① requires no special skills: '특별한 기술이 불필요하다'는 딥워크의 높은 인지적 요구와 모순
❌ ② involves simple repetitive tasks: '단순 반복 과제'는 shallow work의 특성
✅ ③ pushes your cognitive capabilities: '인지 능력을 밀어붙인다'는 딥워크의 핵심 특성과 원문 일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ produces no meaningful results: '의미 있는 결과가 없다'는 새 가치를 창출한다는 원문과 모순
det.tip: pushes your cognitive capabilities = 인지 능력을 밀어붙이다
